contact.hero.title: Let's talk about technology in your business
contact.hero.subtitle: Tired of unreliable freelancers and expensive agencies? Looking for a partner who understands your business, not just writes code?
contact.benefits.title: What can you expect?
contact.benefits.item1.title: Concrete, no jargon
contact.benefits.item1.desc: I speak the language of business, not technical jargon.
contact.benefits.item2.title: Initial diagnosis
contact.benefits.item2.desc: I will point out possible directions during the first conversation.
contact.benefits.item3.title: No obligations
contact.benefits.item3.desc: A conversation is not a contract. Let's see if we are a good fit.
contact.location.title: Where I work
contact.location.poznan.title: Poznań
contact.location.poznan.text: This is the base. Day to day I work from Poznań — remotely and in person.
contact.location.warsaw.title: Warsaw
contact.location.warsaw.text: I meet clients when I am in the city. The first conversation is online — you do not need to travel.
contact.faq.title: Poznań, Warsaw, remote
contact.faq.q1.question: Do you work with clients in Warsaw?
contact.faq.q1.answer: Yes. I work remotely and meet in Warsaw when I am in the city. You do not need to come to Poznań.
contact.faq.q2.question: Do I need to be in Poznań to start?
contact.faq.q2.answer: No. The first conversation is online. Invoice, code, and hosting work regardless of city. An in-person meeting is an option, not a requirement.
